name: BambuBar
author: tripex
description: Live status of a Bambu Lab 3D printer in the Omarchy bar: progress, time left, both nozzles, AMS spools in their colours, and a notification when a print ends, straight from the printer on your network.

barWidget.description: Bambu Lab printer status: progress and time left in the bar; job, layers, temperatures, AMS spools and humidity in the panel; notifications when a print finishes or fails.

schema.label: Show progress and time left in the bar
Notify when a print finishes or fails
Demo mode (sample print, no printer needed)
